description: Issue #43: time-of-day + state-aware stage background. Add a PURE, unit-tested timeOfDay helper, wire a stage-level container in App.tsx with data-attributes (data-timeofday, data-stage) and state classes (is-sleeping, is-dirty), and drive all visuals from pure CSS gradients/overlays. Vary the background by device local time (morning/day/evening/night), dim when sleeping, show a subtle grime vignette when dirty, and shift hue per growth stage. Must respect prefers-reduced-motion, keep WCAG AA text contrast on every phase, and avoid mobile perf regression (CSS gradients/opacity only, no heavy continuous animation). Keep logic minimal/testable and visuals pure CSS; no new runtime deps. Likely NO new i18n strings (badges already have aria labels).
steps: In packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts add a pure, DOM/React-free helper `export type TimeOfDay = 'morning' | 'day' | 'evening' | 'night';` and `export function timeOfDay(input: number | Date): TimeOfDay`. Accept either a Date or an hour-of-day number. Document the hour ranges in a doc comment and make them explicit and testable. Suggested ranges (24h, local): morning 5-10 (05:00-09:59), day 10-17 (10:00-16:59), evening 17-20 (17:00-19:59), night 20-5 (20:00-04:59, wrapping midnight). Derive the hour via `new Date(...).getHours()` when a Date/timestamp is passed, or use the number directly when an hour (0-23) is passed. Guard non-finite input by falling back to 'day'. Place it near dayStamp() and mirror that helper's pure style.

In packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts add boundary tests following the existing flat `test(...)` + `assert/strict` style (study the dayStamp and careEffect tests). Import `timeOfDay` (and the TimeOfDay type if asserted). Cover EACH boundary hour explicitly: 4->night, 5->morning, 9->morning, 10->day, 16->day, 17->evening, 19->evening, 20->night, 23->night, 0->night. Also assert it accepts a Date (e.g. a Date at 08:00 -> 'morning') and that a non-finite number falls back to 'day'. Keep assertions on the returned phase string only.

In packages/frontend/src/App.tsx compute the current time-of-day from the DEVICE local time and expose it as a `data-timeofday` attribute, plus `data-stage` from game.monster.stageId and `is-sleeping`/`is-dirty` classes, on a stage container. Preferred: apply these to the existing `.stage-area` wrapper (left column) OR introduce a thin wrapper so the gradient reads behind the sprite. Use a small React state (e.g. `const [tod, setTod] = useState(() => timeOfDay(new Date()))`) and an effect with a cheap setInterval (reuse a ~60s cadence; it only sets state when the phase actually CHANGES to avoid needless repaints) so a session left open across a boundary transitions. Clear the interval on unmount. Do not add a dependency; a plain setInterval in a useEffect is fine. The existing per-15s TIME_TICK lives in useMonster and is for game logic; keep this background interval separate and only update when the computed phase differs from current state.

Keep the existing `.sprite-wrap.sleeping` class and 💤/💢/🍖 badges and care-fx exactly as they are (do not regress #10/#11). The new `is-sleeping`/`is-dirty` on the stage container are ADDITIONAL stage-level cues layered under the sprite.

In packages/frontend/src/styles.css add gradient backgrounds for the stage container keyed by `[data-timeofday='morning'|'day'|'evening'|'night']` using CSS linear/radial gradients. Layer a per-stage hue shift keyed by `[data-stage='baby'|'rookie'|'champion'|'ultimate']` UNDER the time-of-day so both read (e.g. a subtle overlay or a hue/brightness nudge). Add a stage-level sleeping treatment on `.is-sleeping` (dim/darken via a dark overlay or brightness filter, building on the existing sprite-wrap sleeping dim) and a dirty treatment on `.is-dirty` (an unobtrusive faint grime vignette, e.g. an inset radial/box-shadow or a low-opacity layer) that does NOT clash with the care-fx overlay and keeps text contrast intact.

Choose gradient colors so that text rendered on top stays WCAG AA. The panels use var(--panel)/var(--panel-2) backgrounds with var(--text) #eef3ff / var(--muted) #a9b6d6 text and sit in the right .controls-area; the left stage shows the sprite and the speech bubble (var(--panel-2) bg + var(--text)). Any text that sits DIRECTLY on the new stage gradient (e.g. the speech bubble is already on its own --panel-2 bubble, so it is insulated) must meet >=4.5:1 for body text. Keep every phase's base gradient in the dark family (near the existing --bg #0f1830 / #16213f / #223359 range) so the --text #eef3ff foreground stays well above 4.5:1. In a code comment near the gradients, state the contrast reasoning: name the darkest and lightest gradient stop per phase and note that the on-stage text is either on an insulated --panel-2 bubble or that #eef3ff on the chosen dark stops exceeds 4.5:1.

Honor prefers-reduced-motion: if any gradient uses a transition or animated movement, add a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block (mirroring the existing blocks in styles.css) that disables the transition/animation while leaving the correct STATIC background applied. Prefer no continuous animation at all; a short `transition: background 0.6s ease` on phase change is acceptable but must be nulled under reduced motion.

Perf: use only CSS gradients and opacity/filter (GPU-cheap). Do not add large images, box-shadow spam, or any continuously-running keyframe animation on the stage. The JS interval must only call setState when the phase string changes, so the background does not repaint every tick. State this perf reasoning in the handback.

If (and only if) any new user-visible label is introduced, add it to packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts for BOTH ja and en, keeping existing JA keys byte-identical. A purely visual change should need none; confirm this explicitly.
Commit the pure helper + tests as one logical commit and the App/CSS wiring as another (well-separated commits) on branch feat/background-theming. Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: `timeOfDay` is a pure exported function in ui-helpers.ts with documented hour ranges and no DOM/React imports.

New boundary tests in game-ui.test.ts cover each phase boundary (4,5,9,10,16,17,19,20,23,0), a Date input, and non-finite fallback; `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` passes with count = 120 + number of added tests.

App.tsx sets data-timeofday (from device local time, recomputed on an interval that only updates state on phase change), data-stage (from stageId), and is-sleeping/is-dirty on a stage container; the interval is cleared on unmount.
styles.css renders a distinct gradient per time-of-day, a per-stage hue layered under it, a sleeping dim, and a subtle dirty vignette, all pure CSS.
A `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` rule disables any background transition/animation while keeping the static background (consistent with existing reduced-motion blocks).
A code comment states WCAG AA contrast reasoning per phase (text stays >=4.5:1 on the chosen dark gradient stops / insulated panels).
No new runtime dependencies; `npm run build` compiles cleanly (TS strict).
Existing 💤/💢/🍖 badges, care-fx (#10), and speech bubble (#11) still render unchanged.
verification: Run `npm run build` from repo root; confirm exit 0 (TS strict).
Run `npm test -w @ddm/frontend`; confirm all tests pass and the count increased by the number of new timeOfDay tests.
Run `npm test` (shared); confirm it stays green at 152 (unchanged).

Read the diff: confirm timeOfDay is React/DOM-free, the interval updates state only on phase change and is cleared on unmount, the reduced-motion block nulls any transition/animation, and the contrast-reasoning comment is present.
Confirm `git log` shows the work on feat/background-theming with no push.
findings: DONE on branch feat/background-theming. timeOfDay hour ranges (24h, device local via new Date().getHours()): morning 5-9 (05:00-09:59), day 10-16 (10:00-16:59), evening 17-19 (17:00-19:59), night 20-23 and 0-4 (20:00-04:59, wraps midnight). timeOfDay accepts a Date or a number: a Date reads getHours(); a finite number in [0,23] is used directly as an hour, otherwise it is treated as a timestamp; non-finite falls back to 'day'. Pure, no DOM/React imports, placed right after dayStamp in ui-helpers.ts. Tests: added 3 new node:test blocks in game-ui.test.ts (boundary hours 4,5,9,10,16,17,19,20,23,0; a Date-at-08:00->morning plus day/evening/night Date cases; NaN and +Infinity fallback to 'day'). Exact frontend test count is now 123 (120 baseline + 3 new). Shared stays 152. Data-attributes/classes: applied to the existing .stage-area wrapper in App.tsx: data-timeofday={tod}, data-stage={game.monster.stageId}, and is-sleeping / is-dirty classes from game.monster.isSleeping / dirty. tod is React state seeded with timeOfDay(new Date()) and refreshed by a separate ~60s setInterval in a useEffect that uses a functional setState returning prev unless the phase string changed (so no repaint per tick), with clearInterval on unmount. The existing 15s TIME_TICK in useMonster was NOT touched. The .sprite-wrap.sleeping dim, 💤/💢/🍖 badges, care-fx overlay and speech bubble are unchanged (the new stage cues layer behind them). WCAG AA contrast: every time-of-day gradient keeps both stops in the dark family near --bg #0f1830/#16213f/#223359 so --text #eef3ff stays well above 4.5:1; a code comment near the gradients names the darkest/lightest stop per phase (morning #16213f/#2a3a66, day #16213f/#223359, evening #121a33/#2b2746, night #0b1226/#141d38) and notes the speech bubble is additionally insulated on its own --panel-2 #223359 background. The per-stage hue is a very low-opacity radial ::before tint and the dirty vignette is an edges-only low-alpha ::after radial, neither of which lifts the backdrop out of the dark family or darkens the center where text sits. Reduced-motion: the only motion added is a one-shot transition: background 0.6s ease on .stage-area and its ::before for the phase flip; a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block sets transition: none on both while leaving the static gradient/overlay applied (mirrors existing reduced-motion blocks). There is NO continuous keyframe animation on the stage. Perf: CSS linear/radial gradients + opacity/filter only (GPU-cheap), no large images, no box-shadow spam, no continuous animation; the JS interval only setStates on phase change. i18n: NO new strings needed (purely visual; badges already have aria labels badge.sleeping/badge.dirty); i18n.ts unchanged. Commits: 7822cf8 feat(frontend): add pure timeOfDay phase helper + boundary tests (#43); a3263f9 feat(frontend): time-of-day & state-aware stage background (#43). No push, no PR.
